tools.name: stocktrends_estimate_workflow_cost
tools.description: Public/free planning tool that calls GET /v1/cost-estimate for workflow-level budgeting only. It does not authorize paid execution, payment, x402, wallet use, or paid endpoint calls.

workflow_id.description: Confirmed Stock Trends workflow id to estimate.

rail_preference.description: Optional planning rail preference. Defaults to auto.

quota_remaining.description: Optional caller-supplied illustrative subscription quota remaining.

max_budget_usd.description: Optional local USD planning budget. Not sent to the API.

max_budget_stc.description: Optional local STC planning budget. Not sent to the API.

tools.name: stocktrends_lookup_instruments
tools.description: Search public instrument candidates across exchanges. It does not select an ambiguous symbol or make a paid request.

tools.name: stocktrends_resolve_instrument
tools.description: Resolve a Stock Trends instrument identifier. The API prefers U.S. listings by default; specify exchange or canonical symbol_exchange for a particular listing, including Canadian securities. Use lookup to explore alternatives. Upstream 404 and 409 responses are preserved.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_stim_latest
tools.description: Purchase the latest API-authored ST-IM record with an x402 payment authorization. symbol_exchange uses canonical IBM-N form; legacy IBM_N is accepted temporarily.

symbol_exchange.description: Canonical Stock Trends instrument identifier, for example IBM-N. Legacy IBM_N is accepted temporarily.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_stim_history
tools.description: Purchase bounded API-authored ST-IM history with an x402 payment authorization. The API data is probabilistic context, not a forecast or recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_indicators_latest
tools.description: Purchase the latest API-authored instrument classification with an x402 payment authorization.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_indicators_history
tools.description: Purchase bounded API-authored instrument classification history with an x402 payment authorization.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_selections_latest
tools.description: Purchase the API-authored base ST-IM selection universe with an x402 payment authorization. This is not the separately thresholded published STIM Select list.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_market_regime_latest
tools.description: Purchase the latest API-authored market regime classification with an x402 payment authorization. Regime is market context, not a trading recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_market_regime_history
tools.description: Purchase bounded API-authored market regime history with an x402 payment authorization. Regime is market context, not a forecast or recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_breadth_sector_latest
tools.description: Purchase the API-authored sector breadth snapshot with an x402 payment authorization. Breadth is participation context, not a trading recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_leadership_summary_latest
tools.description: Purchase the API-authored leadership summary with an x402 payment authorization. Leadership is rotation context, not stock picks.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_screener_top
tools.description: Purchase the API-authored ranked screener output with an x402 payment authorization. Results are research context, not a buy or sell recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_market_epoch_latest
tools.description: Purchase the latest persisted Market Epoch v1 structural market-state context. Epoch is descriptive context, not a trade signal, forward-return forecast, probability forecast, or trading recommendation.

tools.name: stocktrends_get_market_epoch_history
tools.description: Purchase bounded persisted Market Epoch v1 history. Epoch is descriptive context, not a trade signal, forward-return forecast, probability forecast, or trading recommendation. This tool preserves API-authored snapshots and performs no local Epoch calculation or interpretation.

limit.description: Number of persisted weekly Epoch snapshots, from 1 through 2600. Defaults to 52.

tools.name: stocktrends_evaluate_symbol
tools.description: Purchase API-authored analytical decision context for one instrument. This is research context, not investment advice or a trade instruction.

tools.name: stocktrends_construct_portfolio
tools.description: Purchase an API-authored equal-weight analytical allocation proposal. It does not execute trades or manage assets.

tools.name: stocktrends_evaluate_portfolio
tools.description: Purchase the API's analytical assessment of supplied positions. It does not execute trades or manage assets.

tools.name: stocktrends_compare_portfolios
tools.description: Purchase the API's analytical comparison of two supplied portfolios. It does not execute trades or manage assets.
